# weave v0.2.67 - Table of Contents

Graph conflict detection and image processing NIFs for OSINT knowledge graphs, powered by Rust.

## Modules

- [Weave.Graph](https://rbt-weave.hexdocs.pm/Weave.Graph.md): Graph conflict detection powered by Rust.
- [Weave.Image](https://rbt-weave.hexdocs.pm/Weave.Image.md): Thumbnail processing powered by Rust.
